notes: Live LLM call could not complete because the configured endpoint's TLS certificate is expired.
Reranker direct smoke succeeded for two candidates; scores are rounded in this report and no provider URL or credential is recorded.
Agent end-to-end clear/conflict/unanswerable cases were not run because the LLM provider was blocked.
The live-provider overall answer accuracy is not measurable in this run; accuracy metrics below are from the local offline pipeline.

status_accuracy.definition: Fraction of cases whose returned status matches the expected status (completed, conflict_detected, or insufficient_evidence).

query_retrieval_exact_accuracy.definition: Fraction of questions where the set of cited document IDs exactly equals the expected evidence document set. Penalizes both missed evidence and irrelevant extra documents.

document_precision_macro.definition: For each question, relevant cited documents divided by all cited documents; then averaged across questions. Measures citation noise.

document_recall_macro.definition: For each question, retrieved relevant documents divided by all expected relevant documents; then averaged. Empty expected sets receive 1 only when no documents are cited.

document_f1_macro.definition: Harmonic mean of per-question document precision and recall, averaged across questions.

answer_exact_match.definition: For answerable cases only, exact string match between generated answer and the reference answer grounded in the local source chunk.

correct_abstention_accuracy.definition: For conflict or unanswerable cases, verifies the expected non-answer status and that no answer text was emitted.
